title: OpenClaw vs n8n: Autonomous AI Agent vs Manual Workflow Builder
summary: OpenClaw decides the steps itself. n8n makes you design every node. Here's when each tool wins, and why most readers end up choosing Blink Claw instead.
body_markdown: n8n: CVE-2026-21858 (January 2026) was a CVSS 10.0 remote-code-execution vulnerability affecting 100,000+ unpatched self-hosted instances. Self-hosted n8n requires active patching. OpenClaw (self-hosted): the ClawHub ecosystem had 341 malicious skills discovered in early 2026 — install only verified skills from trusted publishers.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) applies security patches to your OpenClaw instance automatically, and pre-vets skills before they're available on the managed platform — the maintenance risk is handled for you.
